detail: National Coverage Determination 110.24 Chimeric Antigen Receptor (CAR) T-cell Therapy. body: US Congress (Inflation Reduction Act, Public Law 117-169, section 1192)
detail: Medicare Drug Price Negotiation Program: a biologic becomes a qualifying single source drug only 11 years after licensure (7 years for drugs); drugs designated for only one rare disease and approved only for it are excluded; low-spend drugs excluded. Relevance: one-time gene therapies with a single orphan designation are outside negotiation.
currency: years after licensure (biologics) before negotiation eligibility
stated_reason_verbatim: A drug that is designated as a drug for only one rare disease or condition under section 526 of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act and for which the only approved indication (or indications) is for such disease or condition.
notes: Statute text: biological product "for which ... at least 11 years will have elapsed since the date of such licensure"; drug "at least 7 years will have elapsed since the date of such approval". Enactment date is the Public Law date.
